requirements.text: The portal should allow patients to book, cancel, or reschedule appointments online.
Patients should be able to submit prescription requests without calling, with a mechanism for guidance if needed.
Test results should only be visible to patients after a clinician has reviewed them, with strong security measures in place to protect patient data.
There should be a way for patients to reach out for help if they have questions about prescription requests or other features.
The user experience should be straightforward and easy to navigate, especially for older patients, while still allowing access to support when needed.
